Title - Praying Azolla Cultivated Plant

Instructions:

Gardens, big or tiny require a balance. Azollah Praya or Prayers, are delicate plants with unique beauty but equally challenging if they're grown in wrong circumstances.

Materials: Azollar Praying Seeds or young shoots; container, water and compost or pebble soil; spray mist.

Prep your soil:

Choose soil that drains quickly as Azorra doesn'' drain too much but not waterlogging either - peat, peebly mix will fit well, but you need a container that's well aeratable to avoid stagnate moisture and mold growth on Azoralia Prayers, a plant known best to grow well near a pond or slow water stream in wild, but they need not to have their foot damped at least for a few initial days. If using compost soil or any type, you may mix with some coarse sand or pebble for improved drainage.
  
Plant:

Plant your Prayer plants either from a pot with small root structure (young) to your garden soil (largely if seeds are used), but ensure not much root is left exposed
